name: Onyxia
notes: Classic level-60 Onyxia. See docs/research/onyxia/tutorial-fidelity.md for the source audit. Tutorial and full fight run the same simulation. Threat burst is additive and cannot taunt; Fireball clears only its primary target; remaining threat survives landing. She walks south before liftoff, positions before the five-second Deep Breath warning, then flies across with a travelling fire front. Simplifications: health follows a configurable raid-DPS clock; threat amounts, exact geometry and some timings are estimates; warrior attacks and the Berserker Rage stance swap are combined buttons; automated raiders and whelp kills are simulated; coloured guidance is a practice aid.

boss.looseHint: She is on the raid. Get into melee range and build threat

taunt.label: Threat burst
taunt.tip: Build threat in melee range. This combines several warrior attacks into one practice button. Use it to build a lead; it cannot taunt Onyxia or guarantee aggro.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Every attack adds threat. Watch the bar: in the red band one more hit pulls her off the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: Big heals on the tank. Pre-heal before Flame Breath and the landing.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Remove a dispellable debuff from the raid.

rage.label: Berserker Rage
rage.tip: Break fear and prevent it for 10 seconds. This practice button includes switching to Berserker Stance and back; in Classic you must manage the stance change yourself.

flameBreath.label: Flame Breath
flameBreath.tip: 2 s cast, 3063-3937 Fire in a 45 yd cone. Only the tank stands in it.

wingBuffet.label: Wing Buffet
wingBuffet.tip: 1 s cast, 20 yd frontal cone: 563-937 damage and a long knockback. No threat loss. With the wall behind you it goes nowhere.

fireball.label: Fireball
fireball.tip: A targeted Fireball has a 3 s cast and splashes within 8 yards. Its primary target loses all threat; nearby splash victims keep theirs. Spread out.

deepBreath.label: Deep Breath
deepBreath.tip: "Onyxia takes in a deep breath..." then 5 s before a wall of fire crosses the room from her position to the opposite side. Move to the side adjacent to her.

whelpWave.label: Whelps
whelpWave.tip: Whelps pour from both egg pits. The whelp groups hold them at the pit mouths. (They do not despawn in the real fight; here each wave dies after 30 s so the sim stays readable.)

bellowingRoar.label: Bellowing Roar
bellowingRoar.tip: 1.5 s cast, 3 s fear on everyone in the room. The lava cracks erupt right after it.

eruption.label: Eruption
eruption.tip: After each Bellowing Roar the floor cracks erupt for a few seconds: ~1500 Fire per hit.

aggroPull.label: Aggro pull
aggroPull.tip: Someone overtakes the tank on threat.

knockAway.label: Knock Away
knockAway.tip: Instant: knocks the tank back and cuts their threat by a quarter. Back to the wall or she turns.

whelpTrickle.label: Whelps
whelpTrickle.tip: Whelps pour from both egg pits. The whelp groups hold them at the pit mouths.

expectations.label: Pull Onyxia to the back wall
expectations.tip: Pull straight to the back wall. Run up the ramp, through the raid, and keep going until your back is on the wall.

expectations.label: Keep her facing away from the raid
expectations.tip: Stand between Onyxia and the wall so she faces the wall. If she turns, move so that you are on the far side from the raid.

expectations.label: Be against the wall for Wing Buffet
expectations.tip: Wing Buffet knocks you back. With the wall behind you there is nowhere to go, and she stays put.

expectations.label: Keep her on you after Knock Away
expectations.tip: Knock Away knocks you back and removes a quarter of your threat. Return to the wall and use Threat burst if Onyxia turns toward the raid.

expectations.label: Take her back when a DPS pulls aggro
expectations.tip: Watch the threat bar and the warning. Use Threat burst as soon as Onyxia turns toward the raid.

expectations.label: Stay out of her front
expectations.tip: Flame Breath and Cleave hit everything in front of her. Stand at her flank or behind the raid, never between her and the tank.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Keep your threat under two thirds of the tank's: when the bar goes red, stop attacking until it clears. A Knock Away takes a quarter of the tank's threat away in one hit.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Flame Breath hits the tank for a big chunk. Have a heal landing as the cast finishes, and never let the tank sit under half.

expectations.label: Be on the pickup spot when she lands
expectations.tip: Get near her landing area as she approaches 40% health. Approach from a flank until you have aggro, keeping clear of her head and tail.

expectations.label: Stay out of the Deep Breath lane
expectations.tip: Deep Breath is a five second warning. Step sideways out of the lane, do not run along it.

expectations.label: Pick up the whelp wave
expectations.tip: Whelps come from both caves. Meet them near the centre so you catch both packs, then walk them away from the raid.

expectations.label: Keep whelps off the raid
expectations.tip: Hold the whelps at the west pit mouth, well away from the healers.

expectations.label: Stay out of the Deep Breath lane
expectations.tip: Deep Breath is a five second warning. Step sideways out of the lane, do not run along it.

expectations.label: Start building threat when she lands
expectations.tip: Get into melee range and start building threat. Aggro may take several attacks if Fireballs cleared your threat.

expectations.label: Drag her back to the wall
expectations.tip: Walk backwards toward the wall in a straight line so she follows without turning toward the raid.

expectations.label: Keep her facing away from the raid
expectations.tip: Stand between Onyxia and the wall so she faces the wall.

expectations.label: Get her off the raid after Bellowing Roar
expectations.tip: The fear runs you off her. The moment it ends, get back between her and the raid so she is on you and facing away from them, then walk her back onto the wall.

expectations.label: Never stand on an eruption crack
expectations.tip: The cracks erupt right after each Bellowing Roar, for a few seconds. Walk between them, and keep the wall spot clear of cracks.

expectations.label: Be against the wall for Wing Buffet
expectations.tip: Back on the wall before each Buffet.

expectations.label: Keep her on you after Knock Away
expectations.tip: Knock Away knocks you back and removes a quarter of your threat. Return to the wall and use Threat burst if Onyxia turns toward the raid.

expectations.label: Take her back when a DPS pulls aggro
expectations.tip: Watch the threat bar and the warning. Use Threat burst as soon as Onyxia turns toward the raid.

expectations.label: Stay out of her front
expectations.tip: Flame Breath and Cleave hit everything in front of her. Stand at her flank or behind the raid, never between her and the tank.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Keep your threat under two thirds of the tank's: when the bar goes red, stop attacking until it clears. A Knock Away takes a quarter of the tank's threat away in one hit.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Flame Breath hits the tank for a big chunk. Have a heal landing as the cast finishes, and never let the tank sit under half.

expectations.label: Let the tank pick her up before you attack
expectations.tip: Fireballs may have cleared the tank's threat. Hold damage until Onyxia is back on the tank, then build slowly.

threatLostCount.label: Times she turned on the raid

pickupTime.label: Time to pick up after landing

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: In the red band one more hit can pull her. Wait for the tank.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had her
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

earlyPulls.label: You pulled her before the tank

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Every global you can safely use, use. Stop only when the bar is red or she is not on the tank.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before Flame Breath lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: A heal on a full tank is a heal you did not have for the breath.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up

drills.name: Pull and Wing Buffet
drills.description: Pull Onyxia from the ramp to the back wall. Hold your position through three Wing Buffets, and use Threat burst if she turns toward the raid.

drills.name: Getting aggro back
drills.description: Start at the wall. DPS will pull aggro; use Threat burst as soon as Onyxia turns toward them.

drills.name: Bellowing Roar recovery
drills.description: Start at the wall in Phase 3. After each fear, get back between Onyxia and the raid, then lead her back to the wall.

drills.name: Phase 3 pickup
drills.description: Onyxia lands in five seconds. Tanks: use Threat burst and take her back to the wall. DPS and healers: stay clear of her front and the lava cracks.

drills.name: Threat discipline
drills.description: Attack while it's safe. Stop when the threat bar turns red, and wait for the tank to build a lead.

drills.name: Healing through Flame Breath
drills.description: Keep the tank above half health through a Flame Breath every 14 seconds. Avoid wasting heals when they're already at full health.

steps.title: Onyxia's Lair
steps.text:
This is the full encounter with guidance. Onyxia will react as soon as you get close; the lesson panel doesn't pause her. Press Esc whenever you need time to read.

WASD to move, Q/E to strafe, right mouse to turn. Tab switches views. The glowing path and marked danger areas are practice aids.

steps.title: Pull her to the back wall
steps.text:
Run up to Onyxia, then continue past her toward the back wall. She'll turn and follow you. Don't stop at the wall without her.

Turn to face her once you're in position. Stay in melee range and use Threat burst (1) to build a lead. Onyxia is immune to taunts.

steps.title: Keep her facing the wall
steps.text:
Flame Breath hits everyone in front of her. Keep yourself between Onyxia and the back wall; the raid belongs at her sides, clear of her head and tail.

Hold that position through the next breath. Her other attacks keep running while you practise.

steps.title: Watch the knockback
steps.text:
Wing Buffet knocks you back. Put your back against the wall so she stays in place.

Knock Away is a separate attack: it also removes a quarter of your threat. Keep building threat before she turns. Threat burst adds threat; it cannot force her to attack you.

steps.title: Hold her until takeoff
steps.text:
Keep her against the wall and keep attacking. If she turns toward the raid, get back into melee range and rebuild threat. The raid needs to ease off while you catch up.

At 65% health she leaves the tank and heads toward the entrance to take off.

steps.title: Phase 2: spread out
steps.text:
Fireballs splash within 8 yards and clear the primary target's threat. Spread out. Whelps come from both egg pits; the off-tanks handle them in this main-tank lesson.

Watch where Onyxia flies. When she takes a deep breath, get to the side of her flight path. The coloured lane is a practice aid, not something you see in WoW.

steps.title: Get ready for the landing
steps.text:
Keep watching for Deep Breath and stay spread for Fireballs. As her health approaches 40%, move toward the landing area.

A Fireball may have cleared your threat. You may need time to catch up when she lands; pressing a button won't guarantee aggro.

steps.title: Phase 3: pick her up
steps.text:
At 40% she comes down. Check who she's targeting, get into melee range and build threat. Once she's on you, lead her back to the wall.

Expect Bellowing Roar soon after landing. The rest of the raid should hold damage until you have control.

steps.title: Fear and lava
steps.text:
Bellowing Roar has a 1.5-second cast. Use Berserker Rage (6) before it finishes to prevent the fear. It lasts 10 seconds and has a 30-second cooldown.

This button includes the stance swap. In Classic you must switch to Berserker Stance yourself; a priest can also protect you with Fear Ward. If you are feared, recover your position when you can move and avoid the erupting cracks.

steps.title: Finish the fight
steps.text:
Keep her facing the wall, build threat after Knock Away, and recover your position after each fear. Stay clear of the erupting cracks.

The tutorial finishes when Onyxia goes down. You can repeat individual mechanics in the drills afterwards.

cues.notes: Reaction prompts for threat and whelp pickup. Threat burst is also useful between prompts to build a lead.

list.label: Burst threat when she turns on the raid
list.tip: Use Threat burst as soon as Onyxia turns toward the raid.

list.label: Burst threat as she lands
list.tip: Fireballs may have cleared your threat. Build threat in melee range when she lands; move her back to the wall once she targets you.

list.label: Pick up the whelps
list.tip: Meet the whelps at the cave mouths. Use Threat burst or move into them to pick them up before they reach the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with a breath coming is where tanks die. Heal now.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Pull Onyxia to the back wall and keep her facing away from the raid. Build threat in melee range. She cannot be taunted.

offtank.label: Whelp off-tank
offtank.description: Tank Onyxia as usual. In Phase 2, pick up the whelps and hold them away from the raid.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Attack from her flank, near the shoulder. Stay clear of her breath and tail, keep your threat below the tank's, and spread out in Phase 2.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stand in the wall pocket beside Onyxia, clear of her head and tail. Watch your threat, spread 8 yards apart in Phase 2, and dodge Deep Breath.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Stay in the wall pocket beside Onyxia, within healing range of the tank. Keep the tank alive through Flame Breath and her landing, and avoid the Deep Breath lanes.
